summary: Read a string s whose length runs from 0 through 300. Each character is a lowercase or uppercase English letter, a digit, or one mark from the set !@#$%^&*()_+-=',.: and the only blank is an ordinary space. Treat every run of characters that are not spaces as one segment. Count how many such runs appear and write that count.
notes: The left column is this sample's input text and the right column is the text the program should print. Comparison ignores trailing newlines.
